# The briefs

What this site is built from: Dinis's voice memo of 20 October 2026, published verbatim as transcribed, and the message that started the session that built the site. The brief is never edited to look right afterwards; where the work departed from it, [the corrections file](../admin/corrections.md) says so.

*the brief 01*

### [Find your startup](01__find-your-startup.md)

the AI startup finder concept, a voice memo

[Read it →](01__find-your-startup.md)

*note 02*

### [The initial prompt](02__note-the-initial-prompt.md)

the message that started the first session

[Read it →](02__note-the-initial-prompt.md)

The memo asks for a finder that works for humans and for agents, LLM-driven first, not passing judgement, and for the site to take over the startups material. [The first article](../articles/find-your-startup.md) says the same in Dinis's voice with the brief for the roles; [the decisions](../decisions/index.md) are the three the memo contains.

The captured markdown is in `admin/content/briefs/`. The guidance the memo points at is [Every sgit repository](https://sgit.ai/docs/guidance/repositories.html), which asks a new repository to publish its brief in full with the initial prompt.
